name: Apartement Tiroler Haus
beschreibung: The Apartement Tiroler Haus is a holiday apartment in Tirol, Österreich. The accommodation is located in quiet surroundings with a view of the mountain landscape. The apartment comprises a living and sleeping area, a kitchenette and a shower room. A balcony is part of the amenities. The furnishings are designed with wooden elements and traditional furniture. Guests are independent here and can explore the surroundings. Ski areas and hiking trails are accessible from the accommodation.
